title: Sort Products by Price
real_world_story: An e-commerce website allows customers to sort products from the cheapest to the most expensive. The product prices are currently stored in an arbitrary order.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Prices of products in the catalog
real_world_connection.output_represents: Products arranged from lowest price to highest price
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Sorting product data before displaying it

problem_statement: Given an array containing the prices of N products, sort the prices in non-decreasing order.
task: Arrange all product prices from the lowest price to the highest price.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N integers representing product prices.
output_format: Print the sorted product prices in non-decreasing order.

examples.explanation: The products are arranged from cheapest to most expensive.

expected_algorithm.reason: The purpose of this introductory problem is to practice basic sorting algorithms.

hint: Compare elements that are out of order.
Continue until the complete catalog is sorted.
real_world_takeaway: Sorting allows an e-commerce platform to provide useful product views such as price low-to-high and high-to-low.
